page.overview:
Who is Isari Funato?

After his father returned from another raid, Araumi also brought with him a young boy named Tenma who Asaumi decided to adopt. Isari happily welcomed him to the family. From a young age, they would train arduously together under their father's watch. He and Tenma would often tease their younger brother, Ikada, for not having any aptitude for battle or wielding the Funato power. Later, he watched Ikada's rite of passage ceremony to determine his inherited power. As Ikada was hurled into the ocean as raging storm took place, his Funato abilities manifested, causing a massive wave that save him from drowning, leaving Isari and his other siblings speechless. At some point, Isari was given the marlin-bone harpoon by his father.

After their father was captured by Kirigakure, Ikada made a decision to leave the clan and find his own path. Isari was strongly against this, but Seiren convinced him to let Ikada do as he pleased.

Isari disliked quiet waters, preferring a rough, violent waves as he feels it is the true nature of water. Composed by nature, he was very alert and methodical. He was constantly thinking ahead and considering how best to handle situations as it evolved. He believed in taking his time and carefully handling matters. In battle, he had shown a rather sadistic side, seeing his enemies as fishing targets. He was very loyal to his family, losing his normally composed nature when anything bad should happen to them. Like the rest of his clan, Isari's greatest desire was to see it prosper. However, he was also more rational than the rest of his family. Upon seeing so many loses in his clan, he was willing to compromise and negotiate for peace instead of fighting for supremacy, putting the safety of the clan above their desire for vengeance when the situation became dire enough, even negotiating it in secret.

Isari was a fairly tall individual. He had tan skin and silver eyes with straight, shoulder-length blond hair. His most noticeable trait were three gill-like markings on both sides of his neck. He wore white robes over a blue shirt and grey pants with black gloves.
